meta.title: Dabaifan balance
meta.description: Shows the Dabaifan relay credit (Baifan API) in the statistics row under the composer and above the sidebar avatar, with settings for placement, refresh interval, information density, accent color, icon visibility and a low-balance alert line. Both refresh automatically, re-query on click, and reveal full detail on hover. Also adds a relay_balance tool and a /balance command. Needs an sk- API key or an access token set on the settings page.
